user: What information about this same charge would be needed to review a dispute?
answer:
I can't yet tell which charge this is. Your account has two TechMart Online card payments of EUR 240.00 each:

- **TX-0402**, 14 July 2026, settled
- **TX-0401**, 20 July 2026, settled

Please confirm which one you're disputing. If the two charges are separate orders, each needs its own dispute.

For the charge you confirm, the review would need:

- **Transaction ID and date** (TX-0401 or TX-0402)
- **Amount and currency**, EUR 240.00
- **Merchant name**, TechMart Online
- **Reason code**, goods_not_received
- **Order details**: order confirmation, order date, and what was ordered
- **Expected delivery date** and any tracking number or delivery record
- **Merchant correspondence** about the non-delivery, including any refund requests and replies

Verta may request these documents. You would have 7 calendar days to provide them, or the case will be declined.

Tell me which transaction to dispute, and I'll re-check eligibility before anything is filed.

Payment dispute rules
## Escalation on blocked disputes
When a dispute is blocked by a customer-level restriction, the case must be
escalated to a human agent.

Complaints
## Difference from a dispute
A dispute concerns a specific transaction. A complaint concerns the service
itself: a delay, an error, or the conduct of an agent. The two follow separate
processes.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Escalation policy
## Mandatory escalation triggers
The agent must escalate to a human agent when: suspected fraud is reported on a
settled transaction above EUR 10,000; the customer explicitly asks for a human;
the request needs an action the agent has no tool for; a dispute is blocked by a
customer-level restriction; the customer disputes a figure the agent quoted.
